item.title: Shiga with Kids: Ninja Village, Castle Cat & Lake Biwa Cruises
item.description: Shiga Prefecture sits an eight-minute train ride from Kyoto, but it operates at an entirely different pace. Here, Japan’s largest lake spreads across the landscape like an inland sea, a real castle still stands on the hill where it was built four centuries ago, and children can throw shuriken at a village where the techniques of historical ninja have been preserved and taught for generations. For families travelling Japan, this is a prefecture that repays a full day or two without requiring a car.
